title: Integration test: end-to-end ingest of arXiv 1706.03762
description:
All integration tests marked @pytest.mark.integration. Requires: GROBID running at ALCANZAI_GROBID_URL; ALCANZAI_LIBRARY set to temp DB; alcanzai binary on PATH.

Tests (in tests/test_m2_integration.py):

1. test_ingest_arxiv_produces_ko: alcanzai ingest 1706.03762 → KO in Library with content_type=academic_pdf, title='Attention Is All You Need', len(ko.blocks) > 10, at least one citation in relationships table.

2. test_reingest_is_noop: ingest 1706.03762 twice → Library has exactly 1 KO; second result.json shows exact_match.

3. test_vault_reflects_ingested_ko: after ingest + alcanzai vault render, vault note for 1706.03762 exists with ## Abstract and ## Content sections populated.

4. test_no_edits_to_library_projection_synthesis: git diff HEAD -- alcanzai-core/src/library.rs alcanzai-core/src/vault_projection.rs shows no changes from M1 baseline. (This is the §6 test #3 partial check — only ingestion/understanding modules changed.)

Acceptance: all 4 tests pass with GROBID running. Tests are skipped gracefully (pytest.skip) if ALCANZAI_GROBID_URL is unreachable.
